'When this is equipped, put a steam counter on it. / Once per Turn Instant - {r}, remove a steam counter from this: Gain 1 action point. Activate this ability only if you've boosted this turn.'

Direct sibling of the adopted evo/cogwerx_base_arms.json and the drafted cogwerx_base_chest.json - identical skeleton, only the payoff differs (GAIN ACTION_POINTS 1 vs the arms' MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK / chest's RESOURCE_POINTS 2).

PLACEMENT DEVIATION FROM THE ADOPTED SIBLING: activation_cost/per_turn are authored at CARD level here, not inside the INSTANT ability. compile_card reads them from the top-level dict only (loader.py:153-154) - an ability-level copy lands unread in ab_params (_compile_ability, loader.py:119-141) - and card.py:519-528 stamps the card-level values onto the runtime card, where play.py:1513-1522 charges the {r} and play.py:304 enforces the once-per-turn allowance at offer time. arms.json carries them ability-level, which is inert there; do not copy that placement.

Boost gate: FLAG_SET reads raw membership of 'boosted_this_turn' in the controller's current_turn_effects (condition_types.py:1032-1037), and ability_keywords.boost appends exactly that marker once per PAID boost, unconditionally (line 514) - so the release note's 'the banished card does not have to be a Mechanologist' holds: any paid boost sets it.

GAIN asset ACTION_POINTS routes through effect_keywords.gain (effect_types.py:4897-4900). PUT_COUNTER with no target puts the counter on the source card, which is 'on it'.

KNOWN WRINKLE (inherited from the siblings' shape): the REMOVE_COUNTERS cost decrements only the player-level counter dict keyed (slug, zone, kind) (cost_types.py:556-572) while effect_put_counter also writes card.counters. With one steam counter and per_turn 1 this never misbehaves (can_pay sums the player-level dict, so a second activation is unpayable and once-per-turn blocks it anyway), but any future card-level COUNTER_GTE read on this equipment would over-count after activation.
